'''2008 Worlds Team Tom Hollingworth LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Hollingworth]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Brian Hunter also on name line. Sheet title who you owe the money now?. Abbreviations expanded best-effort.
